name: Dual soft shadow
summary: A light shadow on one side and a dark shadow on the other, on a ground of the same colour, so that a shape seems pressed out of the surface.
how: Use the ground colour for the shape; no border.
Cast a dark shadow 6 to 12 px to the bottom right and a light shadow at the same distance to the top left.
Blur each shadow by 2 times its distance.

origin.note: Designers on Dribbble post soft-plastic interface concepts, and the name neumorphism spreads.

adoptions.via: Claymorphism adds an inner shadow and a large radius, so that cards look like soft clay.

sources.title: Michal Malewicz, Neumorphism in user interfaces (2019)
